'''Loowil Galt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], originally from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], who served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]] in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Loowil Galt was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He later moved to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and became a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]]. During his career, Galt arrested a negotiator from a defense contractor resulting in the collapse of a business deal. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], a hopeful participant in the collapsed deal, issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Galt for 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to paid for Galt's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="BHPOSG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] found Galt in Coruscant's [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]]. Fett managed to shoot and kill Galt and collected on the bounty.<ref name="SWBH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Galt was a Human male with dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin.<ref name="BHPOSG" /> When on duty, he wore his [[Coruscant Security Force uniform|CSF uniform]] and carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="SWBH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loowil Galt first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' a single player game released on [[December 5]], [[2002]]. The player can choose to pursue Loowil Galt's bounty though it is not required to move to the next level.

Galt had an entry in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' which was published on [[November 26]], [[2002]]. He also had an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' which was published on [[December 9]], [[2008]] where he was incorrectly listed as "Loowli" instead of "Loowil".
